prompt: PRIMARY COMPOSITION: PRIMARY FRONT: both animal eyes visible, low wide goalkeeper brace, shell raised behind shoulders and one forepaw blocks beside the ball. Exactly two forepaws and two hind feet; no extra hands. Use case: stylized-concept. ONE original full-body transparent Rift of Reason card creature. Image1 approved STYLE BOARD establishes cute-horror dusk, medium dark-brown ink outlines, soft textured cel shading and warm jewel highlights. Image2 shipped creature is RENDERING ONLY: never copy its species, face, pose, clothes or prop. Subject: Niklas Landillo, original NONHUMAN public-persona sporting parody inspired by Niklas Landin Jacobsen; never a realistic human face. Body: A small warm-eyed armadillo with a broad natural shell and silver-trimmed padded goalkeeper vest; short snout and four total limbs. One plain silver-and-cream handball held against a forepaw; no film map, human head or national-team uniform. Main accessory: One small plain handball with broad panels. Shell/padded vest are costume rather than a second prop; no goal, net, logo or jersey number. Printed-role rationale: Frozen1/3 with Guard makes a modest natural-shell goalkeeper visual apt. It does not add Shield, saves, healing or a ball-catching mechanic. Jewel accent #C9C9D6 against worn dark materials, ink/forest/violet shadows, warm lantern rim light. Face and single accessory read at70px and300px. Entire coherent species-specific silhouette at75percent canvas with comfortable truly transparent padding around every limb, tail, wing and prop. No scene, ground, shadow blob, card/frame, text, lettering, numbers, logo, branded kit, licensed costume, watermark, extra figure, book, pencil or tiny clutter. Gear is cosmetic and grants no new power. No glossy3D or nursery pastels. Required facing FRONT; no habitual right-facing pose. All extremities and prop fit.
